events.title: Official Reveal Trailer & Publishing Announcement
events.summary: Today we're excited to share our official reveal trailer for DIEATHLON!! DIEATHLON is a fast-paced first-person action game where you race down dangerous mountain slopes armed with nothing but your reflexes and a shotgun. Blast through obstacles, battle monstrous creatures, and choose between branching routes filled with deadly hazards. events.title: Gameplay Overhaul Update
events.summary: This patch brings a ton of changes! Some big, some small.First up, we've added a Perk System. After every level, you'll be able to choose an upgrade to increase your survivability. Perks are randomized, so every run offers a different selection of upgrades. You might find skis with better handling or higher top speed, a shotgun with increased range and tighter spread, or upgrades that improve your new Boost ability.Speaking of which...Boost has been added to the game! events.title: DEMO UPDATE - TREES NERFED
events.summary: Trees Nerfed!Based on player feedback, tree collisions are now significantly more forgiving. Hitting a single tree will no longer result in an instant death. Instead, you'll collide with the obstacle and continue your run. Crashing into multiple trees in quick succession can still be fatal, so staying on course remains important.The goal of this change is to reduce frustration for new players without fundamentally altering the challenge or flow of the game.
